summary: insert_many required an iterator upper bound and shifted trailing elements by the lower size hint without adjusting for the actual number inserted, potentially panicking or corrupting contents for non-exact hints. The fix adjusts trailing elements when the actual count differs and removes the upper-bound requirement. The proposed reversal restores the original function verbatim. Blocked: no detecting upstream test found. The added util::sequence::tests::test_insert_many uses an exact two-element hint and sufficient capacity, so it does not distinguish these implementations; the other insertion call uses repeat().take(n), also with an exact hint. No builds or tests were run.
